method: All nine actual files viewed with view_image at original resolution. Dimensions and SHA256 measured through bounded read-only file access.

images.observations: Car and wall visible; 10 parts / 16 connections; Projects dialog closed. Blocks selected. Bottom: Project opened. Code runs only when you press Run code.
AI tab selected; Status Off. Enable visible, Capture and Forward gray. Camera area says No frame yet. Capture to see the robot camera. AI operator: not connected. Car visible.

AI tab selected; Status Ready. Enable gray; Capture and Forward visible in enabled styling. Camera preview populated with sky, wall, beige ground and side structures. Tooltip over scene reads Mount the virtual camera on the current robot.

Status Ready; Forward outlined; tooltip reads Drive forward 20 ticks, then stop. Car screen position differs from ready frame. Preview wall appears wider than ready frame. AI operator: not connected remains visible.
Status Ready; car screen position and preview wall differ slightly from after-native. AI operator: not connected remains visible; no claim about developer bridge connectivity follows from that label.

Status Stopped; Stop outlined, tooltip Stop the robot now. Enable restored, Capture and Forward gray. Preview retained. Bottom Input stopped - servos hold their last targets; return to edit mode to reset the robot.
Original camera image: sky above centered gray wall, beige ground below, robot structures at outer sides. Wall approximately spans x144..494 and top y166.
Actual image differs from before: gray wall spans a wider screen region, approximately x134..508, with upper edge near y158. Central wall and ground unobscured.
Actual image differs slightly again: gray wall approximately x131..511, upper edge near y157..158; slight edge slope. Central wall and ground unobscured.

verdict: Car presence, selected AI panel, Off/Ready/Stopped display sequence, populated camera preview and differences between three actual camera frames are visually supported.
scope_limits: Screenshots establish visible states, not click execution, physical movement/distance/contact, pixel-goal success, billing or test pass.
No inference about native/bridge execution correctness or number of ticks.
No inference about normal close, process exit code or cause of coordinator assertion failure.
AI operator not connected is observed UI text, not an independent transport diagnosis.
Package/source identities and runtime results supplied by coordinator are not verified by this inspection.
Approximate camera wall bounds are visual descriptions only, not calibrated measurements.
